name: langchain-skills-codex
description: Local-first AIDP LangGraph agent development with guarded CLI TEST, deployment, Registry, model inventory and Credential Store workflows.

author.name: Joel Gangini (AIDP workflow and Codex adaptation); LangChain, Inc. (upstream skills)

interface.shortDescription: Develop AIDP agents locally, evaluate and bind credentials.
interface.longDescription: Local uv bootstrap, node/graph evaluation, recorded MCP/RAG/table replay, regional model inventory, Credential Store setup and scoped CLI package/TEST/publication/Registry workflows. Five pinned upstream LangChain skills remain unchanged. Native contracts are target-verified GA/legacy integrations. Installing the plugin performs no cloud writes or tracing setup. Required TEST acceptance precedes authorized publication; Agent Hub client acceptance is separate.
defaultPrompt: Use $aidp-agent-bootstrap to prepare a local AIDP LangGraph project using uv and existing protected OCI config.
Use $aidp-agent-flow-langgraph to develop locally and close native TEST before authorized publication.
Use $aidp-langgraph-test to isolate a failing node or path with frozen evidence and focused tests.
